## Featured engineering (see https://shashwatkashyap.com/#featured-work for full status labels)

- B2B Travel Portal — role-based wholesale travel-package and visa-request portal (Node.js, Express, React, PostgreSQL, Prisma, JWT). Admin / data-feeder / partner-agency roles, agency-specific markup, white-label PDF quotations, historical price and itinerary snapshots, soft deletion. Built by Shashwat; client details confidential; production release and client acceptance are not claimed.
- File Vault — independent multi-tenant file-service prototype (Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, MinIO): database-per-organisation, dedicated buckets, slug routing, streaming uploads. Known limits: no authentication or per-tenant authorization yet, no automated tests or CI, cleanup script covers only the default bucket. Not production-secure. https://github.com/Shashwat-k-9114/file-vault
- Travel CRM SaaS — in development (Next.js 16, PostgreSQL 17, Drizzle ORM, Better Auth): organisations, memberships, role-based access, invitations, audit log, idempotency, rate limiting, row-level security. Quotation, booking and finance modules are not built yet. Private repository.
- CareerSpoc enquiry workflow — Next.js contact route with validation and honeypot, Google Apps Script endpoint logging to Google Sheets and sending an admin notification. https://github.com/Shashwat-k-9114/CareerSpoc
- ICIEM conference website — public information website; registration and paper submission are handled by external services linked from the site. https://iciem.vercel.app

## Research and machine learning (experiments and prototypes; none presented as a commercial deployment)

- Carbon.ESG — hybrid policy-calibrated framework for carbon estimation and ESG benchmarking; Best Paper Prize at ICIEM'26. Reported in the paper: Gradient Boosting R² = 0.9757, MAPE 5.51%; ESG classifier 90.25% accuracy across 8 industry sectors. https://github.com/Shashwat-k-9114/CARBON-ESG
- PlantGuard AI (evaluated on a controlled dataset only; not validated on field photos), MedAI and ICU Mortality Predictor (educational, not clinical tools), EV Anomaly Detector, F1 Oracle, Fake News Detector.
- Independent prototypes: AI Interviewer, AI-Enabled CRM.
